reviews.title: For the price they are great but not without flaws.
reviews.comment: Very nice. Worth the price. These fans are NOT perfectly addressable. for ARGB. It can work and for SignalRGB you need a custom JSON file. But the main issue is that some of the LED's on opposite sides of the fan are linked to light up together for whatever reason. So it has 24 LED but only 16 addressable.  It took me a long time to figure that out But once i did i got it looking pretty good. You can see that in the video. I wish they had better bearings also. they are not loud but the rotation has the stickers looking a little wobbly. It could just be the stickers. But you can see in the video that they are not perfect.

reviews.title: This is a REVERSE fan, the blades on the fan are Backwards from Normal
reviews.comment: Be careful to understand what REVERSE means.  A reverse computer case fan, also known as a "reversed blade fan" or "reverse flow fan," is distinct because its blade configuration is opposite to that of a standard fan. The blades are designed to rotate in the opposite direction compared to a standard fan.  HOWEVER, what this really does is allow you to pair these fans with NORMAL blade orientation fans to create a uniform look. Reverse fans are especially useful for maintaining a uniform appearance within a PC case, particularly for LED lighted fans. By using both standard and reverse fans, you can achieve the same visual orientation, with all fan FRONTS facing the same way, while also having some function as intake and others as exhaust. This allows for a consistent and aesthetically pleasing look, especially when the case has a glass panel for viewing AND you can set the top Normal fan as EXAUST (heat rises) and bottom Reverse fan(s) as INTAKE while the orientation of the fans are all front facing as seen through the glass window on your case.  Especially important for ARGB LED fan aesthetic.
reviews.author: Catch You Later

reviews.title: Very Good Fans!!
reviews.comment: I was in the market to pick up some more SAMA-branded fans to match the rest of the fans in my pc case. I couldn't find those fans because they were sold out everywhere I looked. I eventually stumbled upon these, and they match the SAMA fans identically. I can't tell the difference between which is which in my case, and I've had no issues thus far, 2 months in. They sink with my RGB hub just fine, and I had no issues using them with software like Signal RGB or OpenRGB. The fans sink with the rest of the fans' RPM and are easy to install. Highly recommend these fans!
